verdict.rationale: Disclosing how AI is used in petition drafting and review is a fair question for an immigration legal-services provider, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack describes any AI use in drafting or review, or separates automated steps from attorney checks. The pages only mention narrative polishing, workflows, dashboards and attorney coordination, with no mention of AI. The 'AI Startups' customer claim refers to its clients, not its own process.
